name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump issues new executive orders aimed at birthright citizenship
changes.summary: The Supreme Court in June struck down President Trump's earlier executive order aimed at ending birthright citizenship.

changes.title: Trump-endorsed Rep. Andy Ogles projected to lose GOP primary in Tennessee
changes.summary: Two-term Rep. Andy Ogles lost the Republican primary for his Tennessee House seat, the Associated Press projects, despite securing an endorsement from President Trump.

changes.title: Trump Signs Executive Orders Targeting Birthright Citizenship and ‘Birth Tourism’
changes.summary: The orders come after the Supreme Court ruled June 30 that President Trump’s previous efforts to end birthright citizenship were unconstitutional.

changes.title: Judge Dismisses Former Olympian’s Felony Charge in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: The move ends the criminal case for David Hearn, a former Olympic canoeist, after prosecutors acknowledged that the Trump administration’s claims of vandalism were false.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump issues new orders to limit birthright citizenship, Iran shares details of an agreement with Oman to reopen Strait of Hormuz, Trump under pressure to find a breakthrough with Iran.

changes.title: Is the Iran war at risk of becoming a quagmire?
changes.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel talks to John Sopko, who served as Special Inspector General for Afghanistan under Obama, Trump and Biden, about the back-and-forth around bringing the Iran war to an end.

changes.title: Trump's Gaza peace plan appears to be stalling as parties debate logistics
changes.summary: President Trump announced a breakthrough on his Gaza peace plan last week, but the logistics remain daunting.

changes.title: Despite Trump's talk of a deal being close, little has changed to end the Iran war
changes.summary: President Trump is under pressure to find a breakthrough with Iran over the Strait of Hormuz, but it's proven elusive.

changes.title: Murkowski says she'll vote against Blanche's nomination for attorney general
changes.summary: Republican Sen. Lisa Murkowski said Friday she will oppose Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, narrowing the confirmation path for President Trump's pick to lead the Justice Department.

changes.title: Trump Targets 'Birth Tourism' With Two New Executive Orders
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is once again trying to restrict birthright citizenship, signing two executive orders that aim to crack down on “birth tourism.” The Supreme Court already blocked a previous effort by the president to limit the constitutional right and critics believe this order will meet the same fate. NBC’s Gar.
